rationale: The root clock and its divide-by-four generated clock are declared on the clock ports, and the enable, data input, and divided-clock output have complete interface delays.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the static divider to a two-bit divide-by-four clock and one synchronous output register.

mutation.description: The output enable is registered only in the divided-clock domain; it does not change the clock relationship.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: divide_by 4 matches the 2-bit counter MSB; I/O delays use the divided clock that registers them.
